graph_admission.decision: Retain graph replay as the production default at all publication contexts. The final six-shape 1+3 graph sweep remains the publication authority.

decision: Close the current exact decode candidate tranche without a new kernel promotion. Retain LCP-D1 chunk-256 grouped GQA, 128-thread dense Q8T16 GEMV, and production graph replay.
